subject: Trouble with calculating fit indices using blavFitIndices

messages.author: 331b448e313706ec
messages.subject: Trouble with calculating fit indices using blavFitIndices
parts:
Hi all,

I'm running into a problem just replicating the example from the documentation of 'blavFitIndices': https://rdrr.io/github/ecmerkle/blavaan/man/blavFitIndices.html (I'm running the first 20 lines)

The model seems to be working fine, but I end up with the following errors:

blavaan WARNING: marginal log-likelihoods under cp='fa' may be unstable.
10 (3.3%) p_waic estimates greater than 0.4. We recommend trying loo instead.
4 (1.3%) p_waic estimates greater than 0.4. We recommend trying loo instead.Some Pareto k diagnostic values are slightly high. See help('pareto-k-diagnostic') for details.
Posterior mean (EAP) of devm-based fit indices:
Error in getMethod("summary", "blavFitIndices") : no method found for function 'summary' and signature blavFitIndices

I have the looming feeling I'm missing something trivial... 

R version 4.0.2 (2020-06-22), and blavaan 0.3-9

On Tuesday, July 14, 2020 at 6:11:17 PM UTC+2, Ed Merkle wrote:

Robin,

Sometimes problems like yours occur if you type library(lavaan) after library(blavaan). This is because a blavaan object inherits from a lavaan object, and R can get confused about what to do. Not sure whether that is the issue or not. If you could send code that reproduces the error, I can explore more.

Ed
